findings.label: Unrelated diagram work bundled in the commit
findings.detail: Commit a4073fd mixes the diagram generator (scripts/gen-diagram.js, scripts/gen-diagram.test.js, OUTPUT/*, package.json) with the widget. Split into its own commit so the widget changeset is reviewable in isolation.

findings.label: Floating dialog has no focus trap
findings.detail: The panel is role="dialog" but Tab can move focus into background page content. Escape-to-close and focus-on-open/return-on-close are implemented; add focus containment for full modal a11y or document the deferral.

findings.label: latestProvider computed but unused in the header
findings.detail: useAssistantChat exposes latestProvider but AssistantPanel hardcodes the 'MockAIProvider · Phase 1' label. Harmless (keeps it honest, never claims Bedrock) but dead state to either wire up or drop.
